image_description: A vibrant rooster (cock) standing in a shallow, rippling stream within a lush green environment. The bird features iridescent black tail feathers, golden-orange hackle and saddle feathers, and a bright red comb and wattles. It is positioned in profile facing left, with one leg visible in the water.
